questions.question: How many numbers are there from 2000 to 7000 which are both perfect squares and perfect cubes?
questions.solution:
If a number is both a perfect square and a perfect cube.

Then, it has to be some number to the power of (2 × 3) = 6

⇒ 2000 < a⁶ < 7000

⇒ a = 4 satisfies the above equation

⇒ required number = 4⁶ = 4096

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: In a match, average of runs scored by 7 players is 53. If the runs scored by 6 players are 121, 40, 26, 56, 37 and 48, then how many runs did the 7th player scored?
questions.solution:
Given: average runs scored by 7 players = 53

⇒ Total runs scored by players = 53 × 7 = 371

⇒ Sum of runs scored by 6 players = 121 + 40 + 26 + 56 + 37 + 48 = 328

⇒ Runs scored by 7th player = 371 – 328 = 43

∴ the correct option is 3)

questions.question: Mohit buys an old bicycle for Rs. 2700 and spends Rs. 500 on its repairs. If he sells the bicycle for Rs. 3520, then what is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Cost price of bicycle = Rs. 2700

Repair cost = Rs. 500

New cost price for Mohit = 2700 + 500 = Rs. 3200

Selling price of bicycle = Rs. 3520

Profit = SP – CP = 3520 – 3200 = Rs. 320

Profit % = (320/3200) × 100 = 10%

∴ the correct option is 10%.

questions.question: What is the simplified value of (cosA + sinA)(cotA + tanA)?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

(cosA + sinA)(cotA + tanA)

**Formula Used:**

Sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

We have 

(cosA + sinA)(frac{cosA} {sinA} +frac{sinA} {cosA)})

⇒ (cosA + sinA)(frac{cos²A + sin²A} {sinA.cosA})

⇒ (cosA + sinA)(frac{1} {sinA.cosA})

⇒ (1)/(sinA) + (1)/(cosA)

⇒ cosecA + secA

**∴ The simplified value of (cosA + sinA)(cotA + tanA) is cosecA + secA.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 720 amounts to Rs. 882 at simple interest in 1(1)/(2) years. In how many years will the sum Rs. 800 amounts to Rs. 1040 at the same rate?
questions.solution:
Given: Principal = Rs. 720

Amount after 3/2 years = Rs. 882

We know that,

A = P + (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 882 = 720 + (720 × R × 3/2)/100

⇒ 16200 = 720 × R × 3/2

⇒ R = 16200/(720 × 1.5)

⇒ R = 15%

New Principal = Rs. 800, new Amount = Rs. 1040

⇒ 1040 = 800 + (800 × 15 × t)/100

⇒ 24000 = 800 × 15 × t

⇒ t = 2 years

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.question: Total trade of Year 1 is twice of the total trade of Year 5. If total trade of Year 1 is 5700 crore dollars, then what is the difference (in crore dollars) in exports of Year 1 and Year 5?
questions.solution:
Given: total trade for Year 1 = 5700 crore dollars

Then, total trade for Year 5 = 5700/2 = 2850 crore dollars

Let the export and import of country in year 1 be 10a and 9a respectively

And let the export and import of country in year 5 be 12b and 13b respectively

⇒ 10a + 9a = 5700

⇒ 19a = 5700

⇒ a = 300

Also,

⇒ 12b + 13b = 25b = 2850

⇒ b = 2850/25

⇒ b = 114

So, export of year 1 = 10a = 300 × 10 = 3000 crore dollars

And, export of year 5 = 12b = 114 × 12 = 1368 crore dollars

Required difference = 3000 – 1368 = 1632

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: If 3a – (3/a) – 3 = 0, then what is the value of a³ – (1/a³) + 2?
questions.solution:
Given: 3a - (3/a) - 3 = 0

Taking 3 in common, we get

⇒ 3[a - (1/a) - 1] = 0

⇒ a - (1/a) = 1

We know that,

⇒ (a - 1/a)³ = a³ - 1/a³ - 3 × a ×1/a(a - 1/a)

⇒ (a - 1/a) = 1

Cubing both the side.

⇒ (a - 1/a)³ = 1

⇒ a3 - 1/a3 - 3 × a ×1/a = 1

⇒ a³ - 1/a³ = 4 ----(1)

Putting the value of eq. (1) in a3 – (1/a3) + 2, we get

⇒ a3 – (1/a3) + 2 = 4 + 2 = 6

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.question: After two successive discounts of 20% and 12% an article is sold for Rs 16896. What is the marked price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
Let the marked price (M.P.) of the article be a

⇒ Price after first discount = a – (20/100)a = 0.8a

⇒ Price after second discount = 0.8a – (12/100)0.8a = 0.704a

⇒ since, the selling price = 0.704a = Rs. 16896

⇒ a = 16896/0.704 = Rs.24000

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.question: The ratio of speed of three racers is 3 : 4 : 6. What is the ratio of time taken by the three racers to cover the same distance?
questions.solution:
Let the distance to be covered be y km and the ratio of the speed of the 3 racers = 3z : 4z : 6z

⇒ Time taken = distance covered/speed

⇒ Time taken by 1st racer = y/(3z)

⇒ Time taken by 2ⁿd racer = y/(4z)

⇒ Time taken by 3rd racer = y/(6z)

Ratio of the 3 times periods = y/(3z) : y/(4z) : y/(6z)

⇒ 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/6 = 4/12 : 3/12 : 2/12

⇒ 4 : 3 : 2

questions.question: Circumcentre of ΔABC is O. If ∠BAC = 75° and ∠BCA = 80°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠OAC?
questions.solution:
Given: In ΔABC,

⇒ ∠BAC + ∠BCA + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° – 75° - 80°

⇒ ∠ABC = 25°

Since O is the circumcentre

⇒ 2 × ∠ABC = ∠AOC

⇒ ∠AOC = 50°

In ΔAOC, AO = OC (radius of circle)

Hence, ΔAOC is an isosceles Δ

⇒ ∠OAC + ∠ACO + ∠AOC = 180°

⇒ ∠OAC + ∠ACO = 180° – 50°

⇒ 2 × ∠OAC = 130°

⇒ ∠OAC = 65°

∴ the correct option is 2)

3 men or 4 women can complete a job in 120 days. 12 men and 16 women will complete the same job in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

3 men or 4 women can complete a job in 120 days.

**Formula used:**

W = E × T Where, W = Work, E = Efficiency, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Given: 3 men or 4 women complete a work in 120 days

Time is taken by 12 men to complete the work = (120/12) × 3

⇒ 30 days

Time is taken by 16 women to complete the work = (120/16) × 4

⇒ 30 days

Time is taken by 12 men and 16 women to complete the work = 1/[(1/30) + (1/30)]

Time is taken by 12 men and 16 women to complete the work = 15 days

**∴ 12 men and 16 women will complete the same job in 15 days.**

questions.question: A train travels 20% faster than a car. Both start from point A at the same time and reach point B, 180 km away at the same time. On the way the train takes 30 minutes for stopping at the stations. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train = 120% of the speed of the car.

Distance = 180 km

Stoppage time = 30 min

**Concept:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the car be a km/hr

⇒ Speed of the train = a + (20/100)a = 1.2a km/hr

⇒ Total distance covered by both = 180 km

⇒ Time taken by train = 180 km/1.2a = 150/a hr

⇒ Time taken by car = 180/a hr

Given: both take equal amount of time when train has 1/2 hr of stoppage time

⇒ 150/a + 1/2 = 180/a

⇒ 30/a = ½

⇒ a = 60 km/hr

Hence, speed of train = 1.2a = 72 km/hr

∴ the correct option is 3)

questions.question: If the price of onion increases from Rs 24/kg to Rs 36/kg, then by what percentage a household should decrease the consumption of onion so that expenditure remains same?

⇒ The price paid by the household earlier = Rs. 24a

⇒ The price paid by the household now = Rs. 36b

Since both the prices should be same

⇒ 24a = 36b

⇒ b = 2a/3

So, required percentage = [(a – 2a/3)/a] × 100

⇒ 33.33%

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: The smaller diagonal of a rhombus is equal to the length of its sides. If the length of each side is 4 cm, then what is the area (in cm²) of an equilateral triangle with side equal to the bigger diagonal of the rhombus?
questions.solution:
Let ABCD be the given rhombus and AC be the bigger diagonal.

So, AB = BD = 4 cm

So, ΔABD is an equilateral triangle

⇒ Ar (ΔABD) = √3 (side)²/4

⇒ Ar (ΔABD) = 4√3

Now, Ar (rhombus ABCD) = 2 [Ar (ΔABD)]

⇒ Ar (rhombus ABCD) = 8√3

Also, Ar (rhombus ABCD) = ( 1/2) × AC ×BD

⇒ (1/2) × AC × BD = 8√3

⇒ AC = (8√3 × 2)/4 = 4√3

Now, AC is the side of new equilateral Δ

⇒ Area of new triangle = [√3 × (4√3)²]/4

⇒ Required area = 12√3 cm²

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.question: The total trade for Year 2 and Year 4 is same. If exports of Year 4 are 315 crore dollars, then what are the imports (in crore dollars) of Year 2?
questions.solution:
Given: total trade for Year 2 and Year 4 is same

Let the export and import of country in year 2 be 11a and 7a respectively

And let the export and import of country in year 4 be 5b and 8b respectively

⇒ 11a + 7a = 5b + 8b

⇒ 18a = 13b

⇒ a = 13b/18

Since, exports of year 4 = 5b = 315 crore dollars

⇒ b = 63

⇒ a = 13b/18 = 13 × 63/18 = 45.5

Hence, the imports (in crore dollars) of Year 2 = 7a = 7 × 45.5 = 318.5

∴ the correct option is 4)
